description: project_routes.getRoutes (GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes): the 200 response is a oneOf whose first branch is a bare `{type: object}`, degrading the whole union to unknown. Collapse to the richest branch (routes + version + limit), then reconcile with live behavior probed 2026-08-13: a project that has never staged routes returns `version: null` (mark version nullable), `limit`/`version` are absent on the diff-mode shape (relax required to routes only), and diff mode adds a `diffCount` number (declare it optional).

value.description: Number of staged routes that differ from production. Present only when the diff query parameter is set.
